locator: Introduction, Overview of the System (printed p. 21, PDF p. 22) and Water Operations (printed p. 23, PDF p. 24)
shows: The Authority is primarily a retail water utility that sells water directly to end users. It delivers about 9.9 billion gallons of potable water a year to over 87,000 customers. It produces its water from its reservoirs, with supplemental raw water from the Flint River. Its facilities provide a capacity of 42 MGD, and current operations give an average production of 28.15 MGD. The W.J. Hooper facility can provide up to 20 MGD of potable water, the J.W. Smith facility up to 12 MGD and the Terry R. Hicks facility 10 MGD. The overview repeats the storage of the 2025 report: clear wells 6.7 MG, ground storage tanks 23 MG and elevated tanks 2.5 MG.
limits: Rated capacities and an annual average; the document gives no highest day. The 20, 12 and 10 MGD are the potable water that each plant with its reservoirs can provide. The average production includes the water sold to College Park.
